questions.question: Which language should the backend use?
questions.rationale: The supplied requirements specify Python and FastAPI.

options.label: Python
options.description: Use Python for the FastAPI REST API.

options.label: Node.js
options.description: Use JavaScript or TypeScript on Node.js.

questions.question: Which backend framework should be used?

options.label: FastAPI
options.description: Python API framework with validation and OpenAPI documentation.

questions.question: What backend capabilities should be included?
questions.answer: REST API, JWT/bcrypt authentication, role-based authorization, ticket management, SLA calculations, assignment, comments, notifications, audit history, and dashboard statistics.
questions.rationale: These capabilities are listed in the supplied project requirements.
questions.recommendedChoice: REST API, JWT/bcrypt authentication, role-based authorization, ticket management, SLA calculations, assignment, comments, notifications, audit history, and dashboard statistics.

questions.question: Which language should the frontend use?
questions.rationale: The supplied requirements request a lightweight HTML, CSS, and JavaScript frontend.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed JavaScript for the browser frontend.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Vanilla browser JavaScript without a framework.

questions.question: Which frontend framework or approach should be used?
questions.rationale: The supplied requirements explicitly call for a vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend.

options.label: Vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
options.description: A lightweight browser-only frontend without a framework.

questions.question: What user-facing capabilities should the frontend include?
questions.answer: Registration and login, dashboards, ticket creation and tracking, comments, notifications, and role-aware administration and support workflows.
questions.rationale: These are the frontend workflows described in the supplied requirements.
questions.recommendedChoice: Registration and login, dashboards, ticket creation and tracking, comments, notifications, and role-aware administration and support workflows.

questions.question: Which data stores does the application need?
questions.rationale: The requirements specify SQLAlchemy with a local SQLite database and no file uploads.

options.label: SQLite
options.description: Local relational database for users, tickets, comments, notifications, and audit history.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Object storage for files and media.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: The app does not persist application data.

questions.question: Will users sign in to use application features?
questions.rationale: The requirements specify registration, login, JWT authentication, and user roles.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users authenticate to access their role-appropriate application features.

options.label: No
options.description: The application has no user sign-in.
